{"people":[{"name":"Jordan","role":"rep (account executive)","side":"us"},{"name":"Halima","role":"COO, customer decision-maker","side":"customer"},{"name":"Ben","role":"CTO, customer champion","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed","role":"CEO","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed","role":"solutions engineer","side":"competitor"},{"name":"unnamed","role":"account lead","side":"competitor"},{"name":"unnamed","role":"our solutions engineer","side":"us"}],
"competitors":[],
"incumbent":"Unnamed existing payments provider; its support was a ticket form.",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"payments started failing about four minutes in.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (relaying the on-sale event)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Trigger event: payment failure minutes into a ticket on-sale."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"The CEO was getting screenshots on social.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (relaying customer situation)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Escalation reached the CEO publicly, raising the stakes."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their provider's support was a ticket form.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (relaying customer situation)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Incumbent support was slow; a ticket form got a reply after the on-sale."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"They got a reply after the on-sale was over.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (relaying customer situation)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Incumbent support response arrived too late to matter."},
{"id":"E5","turn":2,"excerpt":"So Monday morning the COO, Halima, says they're replacing payments before the spring on-sales.","label":"fact","speaker":"Halima (COO), reported by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided","trigger"],"note":"Replacement decision announced; the vendor is not named in the transcript."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"Ben, their CTO, said twice.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting Ben, CTO)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Payments had failed during on-sales twice before; Ben said so."},
{"id":"E7","turn":4,"excerpt":"But this was the first time the CEO saw it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (relaying customer situation)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Earlier failures were known internally; this was the CEO's first exposure."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"Ben wanted us.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), reported by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Champion preferred us; the rep relays this from Ben."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"he told me he lost.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), reported by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Ben told the rep directly that the deal was lost."},
{"id":"E10","turn":6,"excerpt":"it was Halima's call and she made it in one meeting.","label":"quote","speaker":"Ben (CTO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Ben's own words naming Halima as decider and a one-meeting decision."},
{"id":"E11","turn":6,"excerpt":"He called me before the official email went out","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (describing Ben's call)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Ben's call came before the official loss notice was sent."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"They showed up with the people who'd actually be on the account.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting Ben)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor brought the staff who would run the account to the meeting."},
{"id":"E13","turn":8,"excerpt":"A named solutions engineer and an account lead, in the room.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting Ben)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor had named people present, which we did not match."},
{"id":"E14","turn":8,"excerpt":"they said there'd be a shared channel and someone on call for every major on-sale.","label":"fact","speaker":"Ben (CTO), reported by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","message"],"note":"Competitor's specific promise, as relayed by Ben, not verified by rep."},
{"id":"E15","turn":8,"excerpt":"I think they over-promised.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's guess about competitor's promises; not a customer statement."},
{"id":"E16","turn":8,"excerpt":"I don't think anybody staffs every on-sale. But I don't know that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's own hedged assumption about competitor staffing; admittedly unverified."},
{"id":"E17","turn":10,"excerpt":"Everything turned into \"who.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (describing change in customer questions)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Customer questions shifted from technical topics to people after the meeting."},
{"id":"E18","turn":10,"excerpt":"Who do I call at 10 on a Friday.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (rendering customer questions, unquoted)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["language","gaps"],"note":"Post-meeting question focused on a named contact at on-sale time."},
{"id":"E19","turn":10,"excerpt":"Before that meeting it was throughput, queueing, bots. After, it was names.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (describing change in customer questions)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Clear shift in customer focus, from technical concerns to named people."},
{"id":"E20","turn":12,"excerpt":"Ben's team ran a load test in the sandbox and it went great.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting Ben's team)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Customer's technical team ran a load test that went well."},
{"id":"E21","turn":12,"excerpt":"The bot and fraud tooling got a good reaction too.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Bot and fraud tooling resonated, but the reaction is not attributed to a customer."},
{"id":"E22","turn":12,"excerpt":"The uptime history, the docs.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (describing pitch content)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Uptime history and docs were part of the technical pitch."},
{"id":"E23","turn":12,"excerpt":"I walked her through the support plans.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Support plan walkthrough drew silence, not reaction."},
{"id":"E24","turn":12,"excerpt":"who's my person","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","gaps"],"note":"Halima's question about a named person, which our pitch did not answer."},
{"id":"E25","turn":12,"excerpt":"She let me finish.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Halima listened fully before giving her critique."},
{"id":"E26","turn":12,"excerpt":"so it's a queue with a faster timer.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Halima's direct dismissal of our support tiers as a faster queue."},
{"id":"E27","turn":14,"excerpt":"That sentence.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's read that Halima's queue remark marked the loss."},
{"id":"E28","turn":14,"excerpt":"Right before it we were the favourite.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's self-assessment of favourite status; no customer statement cited."},
{"id":"E29","turn":14,"excerpt":"Ben had basically told his team to start planning the integration.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting Ben)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Ben's team was preparing for integration before the turning point."},
{"id":"E30","turn":16,"excerpt":"She wanted to see, on paper, what we do on an on-sale morning.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting Halima's request)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Halima asked for a written on-sale plan; we did not have one."},
{"id":"E31","turn":16,"excerpt":"We don't have that as a thing.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep admits we lacked a documented on-sale plan."},
{"id":"E32","turn":16,"excerpt":"I could have built something with our solutions engineer, and I didn't.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep admits they did not build the on-sale plan they could have."},
{"id":"E33","turn":18,"excerpt":"I thought the load test had won it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider"],"note":"Rep's belief about the load test; conflicts with the customer's muted reaction."},
{"id":"E34","turn":18,"excerpt":"I had logos. I didn't have a person.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"We had customer logos but no named reference person."},
{"id":"E35","turn":20,"excerpt":"Ben presented them to her.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting Ben's actions)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["message","decider"],"note":"Ben presented load test results to Halima directly."},
{"id":"E36","turn":20,"excerpt":"good.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Halima's entire reaction to the load test results."},
{"id":"E37","turn":22,"excerpt":"A name, not a queue.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not named in transcript)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's problem statement; contrasts with our support tiers."},
{"id":"E38","turn":22,"excerpt":"On-sale morning,","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not named in transcript)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's term for the on-sale scenario they care about."},
{"id":"E39","turn":22,"excerpt":"Someone who picks up.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer (speaker not named in transcript)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's wording for what they need from a vendor."},
{"id":"E40","turn":22,"excerpt":"I don't buy uptime, I buy what happens when it's down.","label":"quote","speaker":"Halima (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","message"],"note":"Halima rejects uptime as the decision basis; values outage response."},
{"id":"E41","turn":22,"excerpt":"Nobody said \"support.\" They said \"who.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Rep's observation that the customer never used the word support."},
{"id":"E42","turn":24,"excerpt":"We were the better platform.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","message"],"note":"Rep's self-assessment; contradicts the customer's stated reasons."},
{"id":"E43","turn":24,"excerpt":"Ben would tell you that today.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's guess about Ben's current view; unverified by the transcript."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E33","E36","E40"],"what":"Rep believed the load test won the deal, but Halima's only reaction was 'good.' and she said she doesn't buy uptime."},
{"evidence":["E42","E26"],"what":"Rep says we were the better platform, while Halima dismissed our support tiers as a queue with a faster timer."},
{"evidence":["E28","E26"],"what":"Rep calls us the favourite before the turning point, yet the customer's critique at that point was dismissive."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Why not? (why the on-sale plan was not built)","turn":17,"what":"Answered by pointing to the load test belief (E33) rather than a reason for omitting the on-sale plan."},
{"question":"Anything else?","turn":23,"what":"Answered with self-assessment that we were the better platform, not new evidence."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"A name, not a queue.","ours":"support plans","evidence":["E37","E23"]},
{"theirs":"Someone who picks up.","ours":"logos","evidence":["E39","E34"]},

{"theirs":"Nobody said support. They said who.","ours":"support plans","evidence":["E41","E23"]},
{"theirs":"On-sale morning","ours":"what we do on an on-sale morning","evidence":["E38","E30"]},
{"theirs":"throughput, queueing, bots","ours":"load test","evidence":["E19","E20"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E9","E11"],"what":"Lost: Ben told the rep he lost and called before the official email went out."},
{"evidence":["E5"],"what":"Customer is replacing payments before the spring on-sales; the transcript does not name the replacement vendor or say whether only part of the business moved."},
{"evidence":["E42","E43"],"what":"Rep claims we were the better platform and that Ben would say so today; both are unverified opinion."}
]}
